title: Unarchive feature flag
description:
Restore an archived feature flag to the default flag list. Requires the flag's numeric ID; pass `{"archived":"true"}` to `feature-flag-get-all` to find archived flags.

Sets `archived` to false and changes nothing else. This tool never accepts or replaces the `filters` object. There is no request body.

The flag stays turned off. Call `feature-flag-enable` when the user also wants it serving again. Unarchiving a flag that is not archived succeeds and changes nothing, so retrying is safe.

methodDocumentation.text:
Restore an archived feature flag to the default flag list.

Sets `archived` to false and changes nothing else. The flag stays disabled; enable it
with a separate call. An already-unarchived flag is returned unchanged.
